members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1996 introduces a proper RFC 7231-compliant `acceptsMediaType()` helper that handles wildcards (`*/*`, `application/*`) and q-value exclusions (q=0), making the fix robust to any valid Accept header. PR #2046 uses a simple `includes('application/json')` string check, which is narrower and does not handle wildcard media ranges or explicit q=0 exclusions. #1996's broader coverage means fewer follow-up edge-case bugs.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 is a strict superset of #2214: it makes the same two trailing-slash fixes and adds a `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper, plus it fixes the `shouldAttemptFallback` root-path guard (`=== '/'` → `=== ''`) that becomes incorrect once normalized pathnames no longer contain a trailing slash. #2214 does not include that guard fix, so merging it alone would introduce a regression on root-URL discovery paths.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Trailing slash normalization in OAuth discovery paths (`buildWellKnownPath` and `buildDiscoveryUrls`). Both replace the same `if (pathname.endsWith('/'))` block with a regex strip. #2214 applies `.replace(/\/+$/, '')` inline at two call sites; #2215 extracts a `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper and also fixes the adjacent `shouldAttemptFallback` root-path check (changing `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''`), which is a latent bug exposed only after the normalization lands. #2215 covers the full problem; #2214 would leave `shouldAttemptFallback` broken for root-like paths after its own normalization is applied.
